messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: latency.p99 > 1200ms for service=inference-api region=eu-west PD=INC12345
Alex: acked the page, looking now :eyes:
Megan: saw the dashboard spike, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1600ms. Grafana: https://grafana/reports/abc123
Sam: any deploys? traffic bump?
Ritesh: no deploys. autoscaler queue length + GPU util rising, kvcache miss rate elevated (~baseline 4% -> 18%).
PagerDuty: Alert INC12345 acknowledged by Alex
Alex: canary mitigation: enable smaller-model fallback for high-latency route (10% of traffic). Pushing flag now.
Sam: good call. also can try temporary route diversion to dedicated pool if fallback not enough.
Megan: starting customer-impact check: scanning top customers for >2x latency or errors.
Alex: applied canary via feature-flag; config snippet: `routes.euw.fallback_percent = 10`
Ritesh: KV cache warmup running (repopulate job kicked). hitrate climbing from 82% -> 93% on canary pods.
Sam: canary p99 dropped to ~900ms, p95 ~300ms for that cohort :thumbsup:
Megan: noted. still need broader fix for main fleet.
Alex: opening temporary autoscaler increase: `kubectl scale deploy inference-eu --replicas=14` (was 10)
Ritesh: scaling applied, pods coming up, no restarts shown in logs.
IncidentBot: Auto-escalation would have fired in 3m but alert already acked
Sam: adding small batch-size bump on canary to reduce per-token overhead (will monitor throughput).
Ritesh: tracing in progress, grabbing slow traces and example request ids. No OOMs. CPU on sidecars slightly up.
Megan: drafting customer note: "We observed elevated inference latency in EU region between ~12:03-12:20 UTC; mitigations applied and service is stable. We're investigating root cause." Will ping legal if needed.
Alex: handing off to Ritesh for post-incident triage and impact assessment — Ritesh you're on deck
Ritesh: taking over. saving traces to INC12345, attaching flamegraphs + pod diagnostics. timeline started.
Sam: suggestion for follow-up: add short-term autoscaler floor increase for peak hours and add an alert for kvcache miss-rate >10%
Alex: agreed. logged follow-ups in INC12345: "increase-autoscaler-floor", "add-kv-miss-alert", "evaluate-batch-profiles"
Ritesh: monitoring: p99 trending down to ~680ms across region after scale + canary rollout.
Megan: update sent to impacted customers list (ops-comms sent).
Alex: I'll keep PD open until stable for 30m, then close.
Ritesh: will confirm when 30m stability window met. collecting final metrics now.
Sam: FYI I added a short runbook note: if p99 > 1000ms, do: 1) enable fallback 2) scale replicas +2 3) check kv miss-rate
Ritesh: 30m window met, p95/p99 within SLOs, closing infra actions.
PagerDuty: Alert INC12345 marked resolved
IncidentBot: Alert resolved: INC12345. Root cause investigation in progress (likely kv cache pressure + autoscaler mis-adaptation).
Megan: leaving debrief notes for postmortem doc. Thanks all for quick responses :clap:
